notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.1.0

Features:
-Added Developer Comments: You can read various developer comments by clicking on developer comment nodes scattered around the map, but you must first turn them on from the settings menu (under Gameplay Settings). The comments contain various behind-the-scenes stories and development anecdotes. Some of them contain spoilers so it is recommended you only view them after finishing the game.

General Changes:
-Added a message pointing out that the sponge is too dry if the player tries to use the dry sponge.
-Added flavor text when clicking on certain objects.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a couple cases where player could pickup items by pixel-peeking through gaps in objects.
-Fixed a bug where certain sounds would play twice in multiplayer
-Other small fixes
